```python
# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():
    owner = 'numpy'
    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

    issues = fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label)

    if issues:
        filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
        if filtered_issues:
            oldest_issue = min(filtered_issues, key=lambda x: x['created_at'])
            print(f"Oldest Issue Title: {oldest_issue['title']}")
            print(f"Created At: {oldest_issue['created_at']}")
            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    label = 'Regression'

if __name__ == "__main__":

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":

        params = {

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Describe the issue:

The issue is at line 502 in _polybase.py:
ret['symbol'] = self.symbol.copy()

Problem is that self.symbol is a string and has no copy method. Instead should be assigned directly as it is immutable:

ret['symbol'] = self.symbol

>>> from numpy.polynomial import Polynomial
>>> x = Polynomial([1, 2, 3])
>>> from copy import deepcopy
>>> deepcopy(x)

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):

    ]

        params = {

   - The endpoint for fetching issues in a repository is:
     ```
     https://api.github.com/repos/:owner/:repo/issues
     ```
   - For the NumPy repository, it would be:

import requests

# Endpoint to get issues with Regression label
url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/numpy/numpy/issues'
params = {
    'labels': 'Regression',
    'state': 'all',
    'per_page': 100  # Number of issues per page
}

# Get the issues from the GitHub API
response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})

# Check if request was successful
if response.status_code == 200:
    issues = response.json()

    # Filter issues that mention numpy.polynomial
    filtered_issues = [issue for issue in issues if 'numpy.polynomial' in issue.get('title', '') or 'numpy.polynomial' in issue.get('body', '')]

    # Output filtered issue details
    for issue in filtered_issues:

        print(f"Body: {issue.get('body', 'No body')}\n")

    print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")

        params = {

        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [

    ]
    return filtered_issues

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    label = 'Regression'

if __name__ == "__main__":

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":

        params = {

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,
            'page': page # Number of issues per page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '').lower() or keyword in issue.get('body', '').lower()
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():
    owner = 'numpy'
    repo = 'numpy'
    label = '06 - Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

    print(f"Filtering for issues mentioning {keyword}")
    filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
    
    for issue in filtered_issues:

        print(f"Body Content: {issue.get('body', 'No body')}")

        print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
    else:
        print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    

if __name__ == "__main__":

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import requests

    'labels': 'Regression',
    'state': 'all',
    'per_page': 100  # Number of issues per page

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):

    ]

import requests

url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/numpy/numpy/issues'

    'labels': 'Regression',
    'state': 'all',
    'per_page': 100  # Number of issues per page

# Get the issues from the GitHub API
response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})

# Check if request was successful

    filtered_issues = [issue for issue in issues if 'numpy.polynomial' in issue.get('title', '') or 'numpy.polynomial' in issue.get('body', '')]

        params = {

        params = {

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'

        params = {

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,
            'page': page # Number of issues per page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '').lower() or keyword in issue.get('body', '').lower()
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = '06 - Regression'

    if issues:

        return
    
    print(f"Filtering for issues mentioning {keyword}")
    filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
    
    for issue in filtered_issues:
        print(f"Checking Issue: {issue['title']}")
        print(f"Body Content: {issue.get('body', 'No body')}")

    else:
        print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    

if __name__ == "__main__":

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    label = 'Regression'

import requests

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,
            'page': page # Number of issues per page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '').lower() or keyword in issue.get('body', '').lower()
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = '06 - Regression'

    if issues:

        return
    
    print(f"Filtering for issues mentioning {keyword}")
    filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
    
    for issue in filtered_issues:
        print(f"Checking Issue: {issue['title']}")
        print(f"Body Content: {issue.get('body', 'No body')}")

    else:
        print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    

if __name__ == "__main__":

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    label = 'Regression'

        params = {

# filename: fetch_issues.py
import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():
    owner = 'numpy'
    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

    issues = fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label)

    if issues:
        filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
        if filtered_issues:
            oldest_issue = min(filtered_issues, key=lambda x: x['created_at'])
            print(f"Oldest Issue Title: {oldest_issue['title']}")
            print(f"Created At: {oldest_issue['created_at']}")
            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

        params = {

        issues.extend(page_issues)

        params = {

        params = {

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,
            'page': page # Number of issues per page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '').lower() or keyword in issue.get('body', '').lower()
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = '06 - Regression'

    if issues:

        return
    
    print(f"Filtering for issues mentioning {keyword}")
    filtered_issues = filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword)
    
    for issue in filtered_issues:
        print(f"Checking Issue: {issue['title']}")
        print(f"Body Content: {issue.get('body', 'No body')}")

    else:
        print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    

if __name__ == "__main__":

        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page

            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):

    ]

import requests

def fetch_issues_with_label(owner, repo, label, per_page=100):
    issues = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues'
        params = {
            'labels': label,
            'state': 'all',
            'per_page': per_page,  # Number of issues per page
            'page': page
        }

        response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'})
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            print(f"Failed to retrieve issues. Status code: {response.status_code}")
            break

        page_issues = response.json()
        if not page_issues:
            break

        issues.extend(page_issues)
        page += 1
    
    return issues

def filter_issues_by_keyword(issues, keyword):
    filtered_issues = [
        issue for issue in issues if keyword in issue.get('title', '') or keyword in issue.get('body', '')
    ]
    return filtered_issues

def main():

    repo = 'numpy'
    label = 'Regression'
    keyword = 'numpy.polynomial'

            print(f"Body: {oldest_issue.get('body', 'No body')}")
        else:
            print("No issues found mentioning numpy.polynomial.")
    else:
        print("No issues found with the specified label.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
